scope: Receipt-only consolidation of mixed lowering and imports-only experiments. Excludes the separate index-reconstruction/zipper experiment. No target jobs or archive operations during consolidation.
status: Private research candidates; no production promotion or whole-language qualification asserted.
method: All product pins/counts/timings are copied or derived from pinned local JSON receipts. Products are not re-executed or independently rehashed in this consolidation. Ratios mean candidate/baseline; lower is faster.

conservative.scope: Original frozen IO sources and inputs. Shared checked request; hosted complete backend emission, not native whole-request time. Independent native outputs checked separately.
conservative.runtimeScope: Frozen original IO programs. Same runtime/toolchain; exact independent value/count checks. Optional fixed native45 batches, not a broad score.

broadAndRetained.scope: Exact broad/retained candidate QBE equality on three fixtures; baseline/candidate QBE differs intentionally. Hosted backend/render samples are single observations. This is not a new ten-case runtime run of each source revision.

N1.scope: Fresh processes, same source/Base/carrier/CPU/runtime. Complete source-to-QBE including startup/frontend/output; excludes machine build. Exact independent hosted output per role, not a claim of baseline/candidate byte equality.

N2.scope: Fresh processes, same source/Base/carrier/CPU/runtime. Complete source-to-QBE including startup/frontend/output; excludes machine build. Exact independent hosted output per role, not a claim of baseline/candidate byte equality.

acquisition.scope: One complete emission/QBE/assembly/link observation per producer on the exact same 1,556,351-byte private compiler source. N1 is produced by the qualified compiler; N2 by N1. Generated QBE differs across these producer policies.

N1.timingScope: Whole emission/machine pipeline after preflight, under one outer disk/process guard.

N2.timingScope: Whole emission/machine pipeline after preflight, under one outer disk/process guard.

qualifiedContextOnly.claim: 249.222 seconds is a different 3,085,157-byte source; no speedup ratio is computed against it.

limitations: Single observations, not a paired statistical comparison.
Do not compare reduced-source acquisition to historical full-source acquisition as an algorithmic compiler speedup.

selfEmission.scope: Native compiler execution, complete source-to-QBE including output/teardown; excludes QBE, assembly and linking. Exact predecessor stream hash comparison is self-reproduction, not a proof.
selfEmission.limitation: One source-to-QBE observation, excludes QBE/assembler/linker. Exact self-reproduction is not semantic proof or complete promotion qualification.

importsOnly.scope: Original generic lowering and independent verifiers retained; only direct-import renderer ablation. Hosted backend/render samples are single observations; generated runtime is separate.
importsOnly.interpretation: Mandelbrot/Unicode execution gains survive without omitted generic construction. Does not establish a native whole-compiler acquisition gain; no imports-only native compiler image acquired.

compilerCodeCensus.scope: Offline static assembly/source census. Not dynamic instruction counts, runtime profiles, omitted-body counts or same-generation compiler timing. Earlier Phase161 owner names select inspection only.
compilerCodeCensus.limitation: Static symbol/category/forwarder counts are not dynamic hotness or time attribution.

limitations: Ten conservative runtime cases, two pairs each; coverage-closures-64 has only 4.5ms medians and is explicitly unresolved.
Broad and retained variants have three exact-output bridge cases, not full runtime requalification.
Three native small requests are insufficient to predict full compiler-source execution; N2 Map/Set regresses.
Fresh process requests use the same authenticated Base carrier (cache mode), so cold process is not cold Base-source reconstruction.
Different source closures, output policies and timing regions must not be mixed into a headline speedup.
Source checking and finite refusal controls do not prove whole-language semantics or stack safety.
No default compiler selection, production edit, new target execution or archive operation is part of this consolidation.
